Name: Japhia, Son of David
Summary: Japhia, son of David, was born at Jerusalem and named among the sons born to him there. He is distinct from Japhia, king of Lachish.
KeyStory: Japhia son of David was born at Jerusalem, sharing a name with a Canaanite king.
LifeLesson: A prince and a foreign king can share a name and nothing else.
